desc: The DAKA Utility Organizer is a durable, weather-resistant, compact case designed to protect, store, and secure your gear. Reinforced by its semi-rigid construction, the Utility Organizer provides extra protection to important items, making it the perfect tool kit, first-aid kit, admin pouch, travel kit, or electronics case. The exterior features a water-resistant YKK® AquaGuard® zipper with a large zipper pull for easy access and closure. The oversized pull tab and carabiner pass-through keep your gear at hand when you need it, and the pen dot matrix makes ID of what’s stored within easy. The interior consists of one zippered mesh pocket on one side; on the other side are two vertical pockets and three elastic pass-throughs capable of storing tools, pens, documents, and managing cables.
